verdict.rationale: The speech-to-text convert API documents a parameter for "additional formats to export the transcript to," and the product page says captions and subtitles can be created via the API. That gives a documented first-party export path. However, the evidence never names SRT or VTT as supported formats. missing for 10: explicit documentation that SRT and VTT are among the export formats, request/response examples of caption output, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the caption export.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export a transcript as SRT or VTT captions through the API or a documented path
